[RTCT.3.1] A conforming `.dsrt` or `.profile` file is a UTF-8
YAML 1.2 document with the layout in [RTCT.3.2]. The compiler
parses only the top-level `contract:` mapping ([RTCT.4.1]); the
runtime sees the contract via the embedded `RealtimeContract` atom and
never reads any YAML file. The other sections are informational
and SHOULD be present in profile-binary output but MAY be
omitted, regenerated, or deleted by the author at any time.
